description:
OBJECTIVE: Switch the repository to the fragment workflow. Migrate the current [Unreleased] bullets into changelog.d fragments, leave [Unreleased] permanently empty, enforce 'user-facing PRs add an entry' in the always-required ci-paths job, and remove the merge=union rule that GitHub never honors.

CHANGE (re-verify locations against the live tree first):
 1. One-time conversion (script is RUN, NOT committed): one file per top-level [Unreleased] bullet -> changelog.d/unreleased-NNN-<slug>.json; the heading is the category (both '### Fixed' headings map to fixed); a '**BREAKING: ...**' lead becomes breaking+lead; nested '  - ' lines become details; strip any trailing (#N). Then empty [Unreleased] in CHANGELOG.md. Do NOT touch [0.5.0rc1] or any released section.
 2. Acceptance of conversion: make changelog-preview output, diffed ignoring line wrapping, contains every original bullet; paste the diff summary in the PR. Migrate suspected internal bullets (CI/test-gate items, e.g. those from #3259, #3256, #3255, #3191) AS-IS and list them in the PR body for the curator - never drop silently, never decide user-relevance here.
 3. .github/changelog-paths.txt (manifest format via _project/scripts/soundness_paths._load_rules): prefix benchbox/, _sources/, _binaries/; file pyproject.toml, MANIFEST.in; except benchbox/utils/VERSION_MANAGEMENT.md. Do NOT reuse soundness-paths.txt (different question).
 4. ci.yml: new step in ci-paths after 'Classify changed paths': python scripts/changelog_fragments.py check --base-sha "$EVENT_BASE_SHA" --changed-list .ci-paths/changed.txt; PR title via env var (never interpolated into shell); includes the [Unreleased]-must-be-blank guard (every PR) and the required-entry rule using select's release-identity-changed output (prep PRs exempt). ci-paths is already required, so no ruleset change. Document that title edits do not re-run it (ci.yml skips ci-paths on text edits); a push re-evaluates.
 5. Local: make changelog-check added to make pr-preflight; make pr-open runs the required-entry check with its TITLE before pushing, next to the existing conflict refusal.
 6. Path classification: add changelog.d/** to the safe-content path filter (.github/path-filters.yml) but keep fragments NOT inert (inert-paths.txt) because release tooling reads them; update scripts/canary_impact.py/MANIFEST.in only if the live tree shows they need it.
 7. Remove the union rule (.gitattributes line for CHANGELOG.md), tests/unit/release/test_changelog_union_merge.py, and the union text in CONTRIBUTING.md and docs/internal/release-guide.md ('Changelog merges'); add changelog.d/README.md (how to write an entry, categories, internal form, make targets).
 8. AGENTS.md rule [CHANGELOG-001]: never edit CHANGELOG.md; add a fragment with make changelog-entry (internal changes use INTERNAL=...). Update CONTRIBUTING.md, .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md and .github/RELEASE_PR_TEMPLATE.md. Keep AGENTS.md compact (link to changelog.d/README.md).
 9. Update tracker item dlv2-52-release-rehearsal-and-first-release context (update_item): the 0.5.0 final prep now compiles fragments and folds [0.5.0rc1]; mention that check_tag_claims/test_changelog_tag_guard may need handling for an undated-tag [0.5.0] section.

DECISION GATES:
  G0 changelog-fragments-02 merged on develop; make release-check VERSION=<current> green on develop.
  G1 Release-safety gate (live, at PR open and before arming): no open release-prep PR, no in-progress release-v2.yml run, no 0.5.0 prep in flight. If any holds, STOP and record waiting.
  G2 Conversion completeness: every pre-migration [Unreleased] top-level bullet maps to exactly one fragment (count equality recorded) and preview diff shows no loss.
  G3 In-flight PR impact: list open PRs that edit CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] (gh pr list + files) in the PR body with the one-line conversion instruction. Do NOT push to, comment on, or close other authors' PRs.
  G4 Soundness review: ci.yml/AGENTS.md/templates are soundness paths: oracle review; resolve all threads; arm only on success of the current head.

GUARDRAILS: linked worktree only; AGENTS.md rules; ruleset/required-check settings are owner-only - make no ruleset change (ci-paths is already required); never edit released CHANGELOG sections; never commit the conversion script; no tags/branches/labels/environments; no skipped or quarantined tests; durable PR text with no process labels; make pr-preflight once, make pr-open, monitor to merge. If CI reveals the new step blocks unrelated PRs unexpectedly, fix forward or revert via PR - do not bypass checks.
